revision: Fix: after Queue, Search or Quick Settings was opened from Immersive, the touch loop treated Immersive as owning every touch, so Back, the Quick Settings pull-down and the Home swipe stopped working on every screen. Immersive now owns gestures only on its own screen and ends once Back can no longer reach it.
